known_red_not_ours.what: python -m fuzzlab.verify exits 1; stage 3 runs engine-rig's own suite and 5 tests in engine-rig/tests/test_heldout.py fail with TypeError: Law.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'scope_exhaustive'
known_red_not_ours.cause: a semantic merge conflict between E-15 and E-17: E-15 turned Law.scope_exhaustive from a dataclass field into a derived property, E-17's heldout harness still passes it to the constructor. Textually clean merge, different files.
known_red_not_ours.evidence: git diff --stat 92b140db HEAD -- engine-rig is empty; engine-rig alone reports 5 failed, 548 passed, 27 skipped; fuzzlab's own two verify stages are ok
known_red_not_ours.disposition: reported, not fixed -- fuzzlab never modifies engine-rig, and it is not this item's ticket. See RUN_STATE.md section 8.
